name: Peirs
description: Peirs was a planet within the Peirs system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector. Connected to the neighboring planets of Gandle Ott, Shintel and Ivatch by hyperlanes, Peirs supported a small colony whose economy was based around supplying ore and natural resources to Gandle Ott.
lead_paragraphs: Peirs was a planet within the Peirs system of the Outer Rim Territories' Kathol sector.
